questions.stem: -15 Choose the correct letter A, B or C. MANHAM PORT 11. Why did a port originally develop at Manham?

options.text: It was safe from enemy attack
It was convenient for river transport
It had a good position on the sea coast

questions.stem: What caused Manham’s sudden expansion during the Industrial Revolution?

options.text: the improvement in mining techniques
the increase in demand for metals
the discovery of tin in the area

questions.stem: Why did rocks have to be sent away from Manham to be processed?

options.text: shortage of fuel
poor transport systems
lack of skills among local people

questions.stem: What happened when the port declined in the twentieth century?

options.text: The workers went away
Traditional skills were lost
Buildings were used for new purposes

questions.stem: What did the Manham Trust hope to do?

options.text: discover the location of the original port
provide jobs for the unemployed
rebuild the port complex
